newsitem.title: USA: Duke to shut Oconee 1 nuclear unit Friday.
newsitem.headline: Duke to shut Oconee 1 nuclear unit Friday.

text.p: Duke Power Co said Monday it plans to shut its 846 megawatt (MW) Oconee 1 nuclear unit later this week for repairs.
"They are looking to take it down toward the latter part of the week," said company spokesman Rick Zuercher.
The Nuclear Regulatory Commission, (NRC) in its daily status report, said the unit might be taken off line Friday so operators could "repair reactor coolant pump vibration."
The unit, in Seneca, S.C., is currently operating at full power.
The adjacent unit 2, also rated at 846 MW, is operating at 100 percent power. The 846 MW unit 3 was running at 95 percent and increasing power after shutting down for a short time last week.
